title: Bayesian Constraints on the Neutron Star Equation of State with a Smooth Hadron-Quark Crossover
summary: We perform a Bayesian inference of the dense-matter equation of state (EOS) within a unified framework that incorporates hadronic matter, quark matter, and a smooth hadron-to-quark crossover. The EOS is constrained using physical consistency conditions, gravitational wave data from GW170817, NICER mass versus radius measurements, and hypothetical future high-precision radius observations.
